items.title: Catherine Russell interviewed by Monk Rowe, Utica, New York, October 26, 2018
items.q: I got to sing with James Taylor’s back-up singers... Catherine has provided background vocals for a lengthy list of notable recording artists, including ... James Taylor.

ctx.x: With Shirley Caesar, like sitting, the great Shirley Caesar sitting right in front of me. And I didn’t get nervous. That was really fun. And singing at the White House. So I got to sing with James Taylor’s back-up singers — Kate Markowitz and Arnold McCuller.
